mechanism: compact term dictionary (sorted concatenated base + overlay) and delta-varint posting lists in src/core/documents/postings.rs; file-backed chunk text (src/core/documents/text.rs) which is inert in this protocol because the serving fixture stores no chunk text (documents.text stayed 0 bytes in every cell store)
protocol: serving-v30 controller derived as serving-v37-monotonic-v1 on writerslogic-02 (WSL2, Intel Ultra 9 185H): 11 rounds, 33 cells, 324 NFCorpus queries x 8 passes = 2592 operations per cell, arms baseline / candidate-v37 / sqlite-full (Node 26.8.1 package with the node-api,security features; SQLite 3.53.4), monotonic RSS brackets, 20 s pauses, load threshold 3
run: 2026-10-17, attempt 4 of serving-v37-monotonic-v1/relaunch.sh; all 33 load gates met; the campaign's final timing-lock receipt write failed on a stale receipt file left by the aborted attempt 3, so completion.json is absent while measurements.json and analysis.json are complete

oracle.cross_arm_rows_exact: the driver asserts candidate rows == baseline rows (full JSON, f64 bits) every round and completed all 11

index_bytes.note: a fixed 64 MiB arena segment plus store.json and indices.json for both arms; the candidate's documents.text is 0 bytes because the fixture stores no chunk text; in-memory bytes are the metric

ratio_to_previous_accepted.note: V30's 0.9133 included binding-side reductions (documents/metadata.rs, node_projection.rs, node_result_strings.rs) that exist only in the retained V30 capsule, not in the main tree; V37 is the main tree plus this mechanism

bound: sqlite-full static RSS 102.7 MB and serving max 181.9 MB in this run; the HMS native footprint above the Node runtime (candidate static 119.9 MB) is about 17 MB, so a zero native footprint would give about 0.84 of sqlite-full's serving max here, which is below the 0.75 target
